scope: Offline rest-surface fitting and target attribute transfer
inputs: body and aligned module triangles in explicit common units
declared support distance and local repair budget
target skin influence limit and discard budget
outputs: continuous body and module seam with preserved render aliases
sparse original-vertex lineage for both surfaces
invariants: existing body part boundaries remain fixed
seam position and skin attributes agree across aliases
source UV and support banks remain available separately
source quantized skin sums are preserved
